target: doctor.sh forge section (github) — failed gh auth status is [FAIL]; an authenticated gh is [ok] with nothing failing
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://github.com/o/r.git
fx_gh auth_status 1 "not logged in"
fx_doctor
fx_sec_has bad_fail '\[FAIL\]'
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
fx_doctor
fx_sec_has good_fail '\[FAIL\]'
fx_sec_has good_warn '\[WARN\]'
[[ "$(fx_sec_count '\[ok\]')" -ge 2 ]] && echo good_ok_multi=yes || echo good_ok_multi=no
echo "auth_calls=$(fx_count gh auth status)"
fx_done
